transfer.title: Import / Export
transfer.subtitle: Back up and restore your data

settings.autosaveHint: Changes are stored in your browser automatically.

privacy.localOnly: All data stays on your device
privacy.localOnlyHint: TournaCore has no server. Nothing you enter ever leaves this browser.

error.boundaryHint: Your saved data is not affected.

bracket.label: Bracket
bracket.empty: This stage has no matches yet.
bracket.arrangementHint: Change this only if the pairings look wrong. A result remembers its position in the bracket, not the teams — switching reassigns them, and it is reversible at any time.

tournaments.emptyHint: Create a demo tournament to try out the bracket.
tournaments.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted, along with its stages and results.
tournaments.deleteDetail: {{matches}} stored matches will be lost. This cannot be undone.

result.title: Record result
result.participantsUnknown: The participants are not determined yet. Results can be entered once both sides are known.

wizard.title: New tournament
wizard.subtitle: A finished bracket in four steps
wizard.participantsHint: One team per line. Optionally a country code at the end, e.g. "Nova Collective, DE".
wizard.formatHint: Single elimination: knockout with automatic byes for an uneven number of teams.
wizard.thirdPlaceHint: An extra match between the two semifinal losers.

field.name: Tournament name
field.bracketReset: Bracket reset in the grand final

formatHintFor.single_elimination: Knockout. One loss and you are out; uneven fields get automatic byes.
formatHintFor.round_robin: Everyone plays everyone, ranked by a table. No knockout — the table decides.
formatHintFor.group_stage: Several groups play round robins in parallel. The top places can carry over into a knockout.
formatHintFor.double_elimination: Two lives: one defeat drops you into the loser bracket.
formatHintFor.swiss: A fixed number of rounds, equal scores meet. Nobody is knocked out.

wizard.previewGroupsWithPlayoffs: {{groups}} groups, top {{advance}} of each reach the playoffs
wizard.bracketResetHint: The loser bracket winner has to win twice.
wizard.swissRoundsHint: At least {{rounds}} rounds are recommended for this field.

teams.emptyHint: Teams are created automatically when you set up a tournament — or add them here directly.
teams.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be permanently removed from the team database.
teams.deleteDetail: The team appears in {{count}} tournaments, which will show "Unknown team" afterwards. Archiving is the gentler option.

statistics.eloEmptyHint: A ranking appears once matches have been played and results recorded.
statistics.eloExplainer: Every team starts at {{start}}. Walkovers do not count. Ratings below {{provisional}} matches are provisional.

transfer.exportHint: Saves every tournament, team and result as a JSON file on your device. With no server, this is the only backup there is.
transfer.importHint: Reads a previously exported file. It is validated in full before anything is applied.
transfer.migrated: The file came from schema {{from}} and was lifted to {{to}}.

modeHint.merge: Existing data is kept. On an id collision the imported version wins.
modeHint.replace: All existing data is deleted and replaced by the file.

transfer.backupNote: A snapshot of the current state is taken automatically before importing.

error.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
error.not_an_object: The file contains no tournament data.
error.missing_version: The file has no schema version. Did it come from TournaCore?
error.future_version: The file was written by a newer version. Please update TournaCore.
error.schema_mismatch: The file structure does not match. Nothing was applied.
error.missing_migration: There is no migration path for that schema version.

challonge.title: Bring in from Challonge
challonge.hint: TournaCore fetches nothing — no server, no outbound connections. Open the tournament data yourself and paste it here.
challonge.step1: Open challonge.com/<slug>.json in a new tab.
challonge.step3: Paste it here, check it, bring it in.
challonge.name: Tournament name
challonge.nameHint: Only needed for public brackets — their data carries no name.
challonge.notJson: That is not valid JSON. Did you copy the whole page?
challonge.unreadable: The data could not be read.
challonge.contested: {{count}} result(s) where Challonge’s winner disagrees with the score. The winner is kept.
challonge.unplaced: {{count}} result(s) with no matching fixture — that history will be missing.
challonge.acceptPartial: I understand {{count}} result(s) will be missing.

note.group_stages: Group stages are not supported yet — this tournament is skipped.
note.grand_final_skipped: Challonge skipped the grand final; a single one is used here.
note.swiss_recomputed: Swiss pairings are recomputed here and may differ from Challonge’s.
note.loser_bracket_order: Loser bracket drawn with the “{{order}}” arrangement to match the source. It allows rematches the default avoids.

routeError.staleHint: This site was updated while the tab was open. Reloading fetches the current version.
